name: Tanz auf dem Vulkan
overview: Victor Bolscho, the aging owner of a dance company, is thinking about retirement. But when he is presented with the script for a musical, he decides to try and fulfill his biggest dream: staging his own musical. However, things do not go according to plan and Victor has to deal with all kinds of problems, from financial problems to the infidelity of his wife to a serious road accident involving many company members.
